counts_note: COUNTS DIFFER - WHY: the coalition's 5 missiles = 3 over Riyadh + 2 over Jizan; some reports count only the 3 over Riyadh. Iran's Bahrain strike is shown as a CLAIM: Tehran says it hit US radars; Bahrain says only a civilian site burned.
date_check: DATE CHECK - Left out because they are Friday's news, not Saturday's: Wall Street's fall into a correction - the Russian barrage that hit Kyiv's bridges - the missile that landed in Poland - the UK-EU youth-mobility deal - Cyclone Akvan's landfall - Anthropic's IPO debut - the ICJ Myanmar verdict - the Trump-Xi-Putin summit - the GTA VI launch. Chapo Isidro was caught on Friday night; Mexico announced it on Saturday morning, so it counts as Saturday's news.

subhead: Iran hits US bases in Bahrain, climate talks run into overtime with no deal, and a deep 6.7 quake shakes Peru - on a Saturday of war, diplomacy and sport.
